_comment: Same domain as good.json, with defects seeded on purpose, at least one per family of checks. It is a manual acceptance test: every defect listed in examples/README.md must show in the report.

sources.text: We need that when a topic receives the third report from different users, it goes to the review queue as one item, and the moderator is told only once.
The review queue has to load the first page in at most 2 seconds with 500 topics waiting, otherwise the moderators stop using it.
Also, the blog editor must be able to schedule the publication of a post, because today someone has to stay up to publish it at 19:00.
A moderator must be able to dismiss a report that is clearly abusive, and the reporter is told why it was dismissed.
Moderators want a weekly summary of the reports they handled.

glossary.definition: Ordered list of the reported topics waiting for the decision of a moderator.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.text: This document is basically about the moderation of the forum. It is worth noting that, in general terms, the goal is simply to improve the experience, and obviously whatever turns out to be needed, among other things, will be dealt with later, with regard to moderation.
